analysis: Books disagree: DraftKings Broncos -1.5, bet365 Broncos -3.5 (look-ahead was Chargers -2.5). The Chargers are 0-4 and finished Week 4 with four rookie offensive linemen -- LT Rashawn Slater, RT Joe Alt and LG Penning all hurt -- and Ladd McConkey (foot) missed the second half. Herbert himself is fine.

With the line cluster priced at -2.0, the sim has Denver by 6.2; real 2026 scoring alone makes it about a pick'em, so the edge depends on the Chargers' line injuries. DraftKings' -1.5 is the number to take if you take it.
